name: studying and deep focus
text: Studying, homework, reading, working, coding or concentrating for long stretches. Listeners want calm, steady, mostly instrumental music with no distracting lyrics, low to medium energy and a soft acoustic texture. Rainy afternoons, libraries and quiet late-night sessions fit here. Lofi beats and ambient soundscapes are the classic choices.

name: rainy day and cozy evenings
text: A rainy day, grey weather, staying in, warm blanket, tea or coffee, window watching. Gentle slow music with a soft nostalgic or dreamy feel. Low energy, acoustic warmth, instrumental textures and a hint of melancholy suit the mood.

name: workout, gym and running
text: Lifting weights, cardio, sprinting, training, pumping up before a game. Fast tempo, very high energy, loud electronic production and confident or aggressive vocals. Little acoustic content. Pop anthems, EDM, hip hop and hard rock keep the pace up.

name: road trip and summer drive
text: Driving with the windows down, summer holidays, beach, sunshine, singing along with friends. Upbeat, bright, sing-along songs with warm vocals, positive feeling and medium-high energy. Indie pop, reggae and pop deliver the feel-good vibe.

name: late night drive and city lights
text: Driving alone after midnight, neon city lights, empty highways, wandering thoughts. Retro synth textures, steady pulse, moody atmosphere, mostly instrumental and slightly nostalgic with a hint of tension.

name: party, dancing and celebration
text: House party, club night, dancing, birthday, celebration with friends. Loud, danceable, high-energy tracks with a big happy drop and a euphoric feeling. Pop, EDM and hip hop work best.

name: winding down, meditation and sleep
text: Falling asleep, meditation, relaxing after a long day, calming anxiety, stretching or yoga. Very slow, very quiet, soft instrumental music with almost no rhythm. Peaceful and gentle, with the lowest energy of any scenario.

name: heartbreak, sadness and crying
text: Feeling sad, missing someone, a breakup, wanting to feel understood, a good cry. Acoustic, slow songs with sincere vocals, minor-key sadness and nostalgic storytelling. Low valence and low-to-medium energy.

name: date night and romance
text: Dinner for two, slow dancing, romantic evening, falling in love. Smooth, warm, sensual music with soulful vocals, medium-low energy and a dreamy glow.

name: venting anger and letting off steam
text: Frustrated, furious, stressed, wanting to scream or break something safely. Loud distorted guitars, pounding drums and aggressive vocals. Maximum energy, dark mood, no acoustic softness.

name: nostalgia and memories
text: Looking through old photos, remembering childhood, throwback to the 80s, 90s or 2000s, a trip down memory lane. Older-sounding songs with warm acoustic or retro textures and a bittersweet reflective feeling.

name: lofi
text: Lofi is slow, mellow, beat-driven instrumental music with warm vinyl crackle and soft keys. Chill, relaxed, calm and dreamy. Related to ambient and jazz. Perfect for studying, relaxing and background listening.

name: ambient
text: Ambient is spacious, slow, textural music with no strong beat. Calm, floating, peaceful and meditative. Related to classical and lofi. Good for sleep, focus and quiet reflection.

name: jazz
text: Jazz is smooth, warm and improvised, with piano, upright bass, brushed drums and saxophone. Relaxed and sophisticated, with a nostalgic coffee-shop feel. Related to r&b and lofi.

name: classical
text: Classical is orchestral and piano music, acoustic, serene and emotional. Peaceful, quiet, reflective, sometimes melancholic. Related to ambient.

name: pop
text: Pop is catchy, polished, radio-friendly music with big hooks and bright production. Happy, upbeat and danceable, with high popularity. Related to indie pop and edm.

name: indie pop
text: Indie pop is bright, jangly, slightly lo-fi pop with heartfelt vocals. Cheerful, hopeful and sunny. Related to pop and folk.

name: rock
text: Rock is guitar-driven, loud and powerful with live drums. Intense, driving and rebellious. Related to metal and pop.

name: metal
text: Metal is heavy, distorted, fast and aggressive with double-kick drums and screamed vocals. Angry, dark and extreme. Related to rock.

name: hip hop
text: Hip hop is rhythm and rhyme: heavy beats, rapped vocals and swagger. Confident, bold and energetic. Related to r&b and edm.

name: r&b
text: R&B is smooth, soulful, groove-based music with silky vocals. Romantic, sensual and warm. Related to jazz and hip hop.

name: edm
text: EDM is electronic dance music with pulsing synths, massive drops and a fast four-on-the-floor beat. Euphoric, energetic and built for clubs and festivals. Related to pop.

name: synthwave
text: Synthwave is retro 1980s-inspired electronic music with analog synths and drum machines. Moody, nostalgic, neon-lit and cinematic. Related to ambient and edm.

name: country
text: Country is storytelling music with acoustic guitar, warm vocals and simple melodies. Nostalgic, homey and sincere. Related to folk.

name: folk
text: Folk is intimate, acoustic singer-songwriter music with guitar and honest lyrics. Melancholic, gentle and reflective. Related to country and indie pop.

name: reggae
text: Reggae is laid-back, offbeat-driven music with warm bass and sunny island vibes. Uplifting, easygoing and positive. Related to pop.

name: chill
text: Chill, relaxed, mellow, laid-back, calm, easygoing, unwinding, low-key. Soft gentle music with low energy. Chill and relaxed are close synonyms, and also close to peaceful.

name: happy
text: Happy, cheerful, joyful, upbeat, bright, positive, feel-good, sunny, smiling. Close to uplifting and energetic.

name: melancholic
text: Sad, melancholic, blue, sorrowful, gloomy, heavy-hearted, tearful, wistful. Slow and quiet with low valence. Close to nostalgic.

name: intense
text: Intense, powerful, fierce, hard-hitting, adrenaline, aggressive, angry, heavy. Maximum energy and loud sound.

name: romantic
text: Romantic, loving, tender, sensual, intimate, smooth, passionate. Warm and slow-to-medium tempo.

name: focused
text: Focused, concentrated, productive, in the zone, deep work, studying, steady, minimal distraction.

name: Blinding Lights by The Weeknd
text: Blinding Lights by The Weeknd. A driving retro synth-pop song with 1980s-style synthesizers, a fast steady beat and urgent sung vocals. Energetic, neon-lit and nostalgic, perfect for a night drive. Similar to The Weeknd, synthwave and retro pop.

name: Levitating by Dua Lipa
text: Levitating by Dua Lipa. A bright, bouncy disco-pop song with a funky bassline, a catchy hook and playful sung vocals. Happy, energetic and made for dancing. Similar to Dua Lipa, upbeat dance pop and disco pop.

name: Someone Like You by Adele
text: Someone Like You by Adele. A slow, stripped-back piano ballad with a powerful, emotional sung vocal about heartbreak and letting go. Melancholic, tender and reflective. Similar to Adele, sad piano ballads and emotional acoustic pop.

name: Lose Yourself by Eminem
text: Lose Yourself by Eminem. A tense, driving hip hop track with rapid-fire rapped vocals, a dark pounding beat and a motivational, do-or-die feeling. Intense, confident and determined. Similar to Eminem, motivational rap and hard-hitting hip hop.

name: Smells Like Teen Spirit by Nirvana
text: Smells Like Teen Spirit by Nirvana. A loud, raw grunge rock anthem with distorted guitars, crashing drums and shouted, rebellious vocals. Angry, restless and explosive. Similar to Nirvana, grunge and alternative rock.

name: Three Little Birds by Bob Marley
text: Three Little Birds by Bob Marley. A gentle, sunny reggae song with a relaxed offbeat groove, warm bass and a simple reassuring message that everything will be alright. Uplifting, easygoing and comforting. Similar to Bob Marley and laid-back island reggae.

name: Clair de Lune by Debussy
text: Clair de Lune by Claude Debussy. A delicate, flowing solo piano piece, slow and dreamy with soft dynamics and no vocals. Peaceful, serene and reflective, ideal for calm, sleep and quiet focus. Similar to Debussy, Satie and gentle classical piano.

name: Take Me Home, Country Roads by John Denver
text: Take Me Home, Country Roads by John Denver. A warm, sing-along country-folk song with acoustic guitar, gentle harmonies and a homesick, nostalgic feeling. Cozy, sincere and heartfelt. Similar to John Denver, classic country and folk.

name: Titanium by David Guetta ft. Sia
text: Titanium by David Guetta featuring Sia. A soaring electronic dance anthem with pulsing synths, a big building drop and a powerful, resilient sung chorus. Energetic, uplifting and euphoric. Similar to David Guetta and festival EDM.

name: Redbone by Childish Gambino
text: Redbone by Childish Gambino. A smooth, funky retro soul and r&b groove with a laid-back bassline, falsetto vocals and a sensual, dreamy late-night feel. Romantic, chill and groovy. Similar to Childish Gambino, neo-soul and slow-burn r&b.
